features.description: Dashboard tabs Ops, Architecture, Archive with hash routing
Tabs follow the ARIA pattern: Left, Right, Home and End move between tabs
Ops and Architecture auto-rotate every 5 s with a pause and resume control
Header pills: events per minute, alerts, analyst replay count, cloud link
Cloud-down banner with queued event count
Trigger chips with per-class colors and the drone ghost chip
Pipeline updated overlay after the live trigger update
Two camera tiles: WebRTC video, MJPEG fallback, box overlay, status badge
Combined people count with CLEAR and FLAG state, meter and breakdown
Per-zone count cards with event tickers
Alert tile: STANDBY, then ACTIVE for 6 s with the rule label and last-alert time
F3 rehearsal holds the crowd flag for 6 s
Platform strip with tier dots and live job list
Footer totals: jobs, events, signed, fused
Topology mini canvas
Architecture view with animated flow lines
Archive view: egress tile and S3 object list
S3 object modal with pretty-printed JSON; Escape and backdrop close it
F1 simulates the WAN going down
F2 restores the WAN
F3 fires a rehearsal crowd alert
F4 arms backpack and drone live
Visible keyboard help
Light default and explicit dark toggle on the dashboard
Dashboard reconnects in place and shows a disconnected banner
Box dashboard with inventory banner, baseline, new session
Departed and arrived reconciliation with unaccounted-for verdict
Architecture page
Live viewer with two go2rtc streams
Synced two-up recordings viewer
Step explorer for every pipeline with real stage input and output
Run instructions
Deploy instructions
edge-sensor --replay plays a recorded scene through the live decision path
scripts/build-fixtures.py rebuilds every fixture from a real engine run
Nightly Expanso Edge updater service and timer for the Jetson
The archive job writes batched events to S3 over TLS with the AWS credential chain
